summary: Iteration 8: Admin Dashboard testing (backend + frontend) plus full regression sweep. Added 14 new TestAdmin backend tests covering auth gating (401/403/200), balance adjust delta/set/404/forbidden, transaction recording, players search, enquiries listing, and stats shape. Backend pytest: 58/58 PASSED in 8.35s (44 prior regression + 14 new admin). Frontend Playwright via public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: (1) Admin login -> user menu shows nav-admin-btn -> /admin renders admin-root; Players tab reveals admin-player-search and 68 admin-adjust-<uid> buttons; Fleet Enquiries tab renders. (2) Fresh non-admin registered user: nav-admin-btn NOT rendered in user menu; direct GET /admin redirects to '/' (admin-root not present). No 'War of Wages' typo observed. No non-401 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin endpoints properly gated with require_admin (401 vs 403 correctly distinguished by get_current_user vs role check).

BalanceAdjustInput accepts mode default 'delta' — no explicit validation that mode is one of ('delta','set'). Any unexpected value falls through to delta branch. Consider Literal['delta','set'] for stricter validation. Non-blocking.
Admin adjust logs actor via record_transaction meta.by=admin.email — good audit trail.
admin-adjust uses window.prompt in UI (per spec); testable via API only, as noted in request. Fine for MVP.
Carryover: server.py still >700 lines; /api/fleet/enquiry still lacks auth/rate-limit.
test_credentials: Admin admin@wagesofwarcasino.com / WagesOfWar2025!; ephemeral test users via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral test users. Balance adjusts applied to ephemeral test user only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin testids: admin-root, admin-tab-overview/players/enquiries, admin-player-search, admin-player-<uid>, admin-adjust-<uid>, nav-admin-btn (only rendered for role==='admin'). Non-admin visiting /admin is redirected to '/'. Admin endpoints: /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/players (search), /api/admin/players/{uid}/balance (BalanceAdjustInput amount+mode), /api/admin/enquiries. 401 when unauthenticated, 403 for role != admin. backend_test.py has 58 tests.
